mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures at 65 degrees with dense drizzle conditions over at Harriet Park. Tonight, look up at 8:23 PM to spot the International Space Station as it travels from the West Northwest over Cross Plains toward the Northeast near Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.
We have no new important emails to report at this time.

For today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market and live music.
In our weekly police report, on September 5th, officers responded to reports of cheese placed on windshields across several streets in a trend known as the Dairy Dare.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel today, but the establishment remains open until 10 PM for service.
